name: Umami Cloud
summary: Umami is an open-source, privacy-friendly analytics tool that counts visitors and custom events without cookies.

free_plan_covers.note: The free Hobby plan on Umami Cloud includes 100,000 events a month for one website, enough for well over 1,000 monthly visitors.

first_paid_usd_month.note: The Pro plan costs $20 a month billed monthly, includes 1,000,000 events, and then charges $0.00003 for each additional event.

portability.note: Umami is open source and free to self-host, and every plan, including the free one, can export its data, so there is no vendor lock-in.

cookies.note: Umami does not use cookies or collect personal data, so it needs no cookie consent banner.

product_events.note: Umami can track custom events, like a signup button click, either by adding a data-umami-event attribute or by calling umami.track() in code.

setup.step: Create a free Umami Cloud account and add your website to get its tracking code.
Open the website's Tracking code section and copy the script tag shown there.
Insert it with the next/script component, instead of a plain script tag, in your root layout so it loads on every route.
Visit your site; Umami tracks page views immediately, including client-side navigations, with no extra configuration.

builder_notes: Umami never sets cookies or collects personal data, so it needs no cookie consent banner.
Load the tracking script once in the root layout, not on every page, so client-side navigations are not double-counted.
